instruction: Candid photographic medium shot in a boxing gym. On the left, the man in the orange beanie (R1) holds a black punching bag steady with both hands, smiling. On the right, the blonde woman in the purple cropped hoodie (R2) throws a punch with her brown boxing glove at the bag. The background features a gray concrete wall with a dark graphic. Soft overhead lighting casts gentle shadows.
